capabilities: Save IMA articles as Obsidian notes
Download PDF, image, audio and video originals
Preserve original folder names and subfolders
Extract PDF text locally and run image OCR
Skip already-saved items and add missing notes
disambiguation: Not a vault sync tool; it only brings material shared through IMA into Obsidian, one way.
extras: Uses PowerShell and local file access, and IMA windows may appear in the foreground, which can show as marketplace review cautions. Cloud OCR uploads whole PDFs to Baidu AI Studio; the stated free quota is up to 20,000 pages per user, per model, per day. Some sidebar text and messages remain in Chinese.
problem: Material kept in IMA stays inside that app, so it cannot be searched, annotated or cited next to the notes in a vault.

relations.evidence: Save articles and files shared through IMA as notes and files in Obsidian.
The recommended cloud mode sends the entire PDF to Baidu AI Studio only after you add your own access token

requires.name: IMA desktop, installed and signed in
Offline OCR runtime installed outside Obsidian

summary: Imports articles and files shared through IMA on Windows into Obsidian as notes and attachments, keeping original folder names.
